(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    // IServerEntitySignature (System)/User
    var user = (OutSystems.Model.Data.IServerEntitySignature)eSpace.AddDependency(Services.ModelServices.ParseGlobalKey("SyNtHeTiCsYsTeMaAaAaAa*DeMoKeY00000000000012"));
    
    /*** creating IServerAction 'GetCatalog' ***/
    var getCatalog = eSpace.CreateServerAction("GetCatalog");
    getCatalog.Description = "GetCatalog (synthetic)";
    
    var startNode = getCatalog.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    var demoVisit = eSpace.Entities.Named("DemoVisit");
    var getVisits = getCatalog.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IAggregateNode>("GetVisits");
    var visitSource = getVisits.Aggregate.AddSource(demoVisit);
    startNode.Target = getVisits;
    var endNode = getCatalog.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    getVisits.Target = endNode;
}
